software.description: Authenticator app for time-based and counter-based one-time codes with optional account sync.

evidence.claim: Google documents offline use, optional Google Account synchronization, use without an account, and QR-based transfer for Authenticator.

software.internetRequirement: Not required for local OTP generation; required for optional Google Account synchronization and online account services
limitations: Encrypted portable export choices differ from some alternatives
software.name: Google Authenticator
software.networkActivity: OTP generation works offline; optional Google Account synchronization and account-related features use network access

privacyDetails.analytics: Not documented in the checked Authenticator support material
privacyDetails.collected: Google Authenticator can generate codes without an account; enabling Google Account sync expands the data boundary to Google's account services.
privacyDetails.controls: Users can use the app without a Google Account or enable account synchronization; manual QR transfer is also documented.
privacyDetails.deletion: Removing local entries, disabling sync, and deleting account-held data are separate actions and should be handled deliberately.
privacyDetails.encryption: The checked support source documents sync and transfer behavior but does not establish a product-specific end-to-end encryption claim for synchronized Authenticator data.
privacyDetails.practicalImplications: Local-only use keeps OTP generation on the device; account sync improves recovery and multi-device access but expands the service data boundary.
privacyDetails.purpose: Generate one-time codes and, when enabled, synchronize authenticator entries across devices.
privacyDetails.recipients: Google account infrastructure is involved when account synchronization is enabled; local-only use does not require that sync path.
privacyDetails.sale: Not documented in the checked Authenticator support material
privacyDetails.sharing: Account synchronization shares authenticator data with the user's Google account infrastructure; QR transfer is user-initiated.
privacyDetails.tracking: Not documented in the checked Authenticator support material

software.privacySummary: Code generation works locally; optional Google Account synchronization changes the data boundary.
